governance: CHRONICLE SPATIAL ENGINE: MASTER SPECIFICATION & ARCHITECTURE GOVERNANCE

mundaneBase.name: Back Alley
mundaneBase.description: Narrow corridor between 4th and 5th Ave, choked with old grease traps and electronic waste bins.

prototypes.kindredLayer: Nosferatu Dead-Drop: External AC units from the computer shop hum to mask whispered conversations. An analog hardware box hides encrypted data files behind the mainframe racks.
prototypes.umbralLayer: Weaver Choke Point: Pattern Spiders swarm the electronic waste and suppress organic emotional resonance.
prototypes.awakenedVector: Technocracy Vector: An Iteration X passive tracking hub spoofs nearby device identities and watches clandestine movement.

mundaneBase.name: 24-Hour Laundromat
mundaneBase.description: Fluorescent lights flicker over rusted metal washers; the air smells of industrial detergent and stagnant water.

prototypes.kindredLayer: Anarch Feeding Ground: A low-risk hunting zone for transient neonates, with a blind spot behind the commercial dryers.
prototypes.umbralLayer: Stagnant Pool: Minor spirits of apathy cling to broken machines and spiritual residue collects around the drains.
prototypes.awakenedVector: Coincidental Sanctum: The repeating machinery rhythm can dampen sensory noise and reduce the visibility of subtle workings.

mundaneBase.name: Subway Transit Station
mundaneBase.description: Subterranean concrete platforms are covered in brake dust and echo with high-pitched rail noise.

prototypes.kindredLayer: Ventrue Domain Border: Mortal security patrols the approaches while ultraviolet glyphs record unauthorized passage.
prototypes.umbralLayer: Underground Warren: Old service tunnels intersect paths used by feral Rat-Spirits and territorial urban shapeshifters.
prototypes.awakenedVector: Void Engineers Outpost: Transit telemetry is used to monitor anomalous movement through subterranean infrastructure.

mundaneBase.name: Condemned Tenement
mundaneBase.description: Boarded windows, rotting floorboards, and structural cracks expose the building's skeletal rebar.

prototypes.kindredLayer: Hollow Haven: A temporary shelter for unaligned or desperate Kindred avoiding daylight and official scrutiny.
prototypes.umbralLayer: Bane Infestation: Spirits of neglect and accumulated suffering feed within the damaged structure.
prototypes.awakenedVector: Nephandic Residue: Broken logic and inverted geometry appear in isolated corners of the upper floor.

mundaneBase.name: Rooftop Parking Deck
mundaneBase.description: Exposed concrete overlooks the skyline and smells of exhaust, rain, and hot asphalt.

prototypes.kindredLayer: Harpy Vantage Point: A discreet neutral overlook used for exchanging secrets beyond formal court supervision.
prototypes.umbralLayer: Glade Anchor: Wind and sky spirits pass across the exposed roof when pollution and traffic briefly subside.
prototypes.awakenedVector: Etherite Observatory: The roof offers a temporary platform for measuring celestial and consensus distortions.

mundaneBase.name: 24-Hour Corner Deli
mundaneBase.description: A crowded neighborhood shop is packed with cheap groceries, neon signs, and a guarded counter.

prototypes.kindredLayer: Circulatory System Node: Local operators quietly exchange protection, blood access, and neighborhood information.
prototypes.umbralLayer: Urban Feeding Ground: Minor spirits of hunger, anxiety, and routine gather around the grill and stockroom.
prototypes.awakenedVector: Hedge Magic Focus: Folk protections are hidden in ordinary product arrangements and lottery displays.

mundaneBase.name: Botanical Greenhouse
mundaneBase.description: A glass municipal structure holds tropical plants in heavy humidity and rich soil.

prototypes.kindredLayer: Gangrel Sanctuary: Animals, insects, and root systems provide a quiet intelligence network within the city.
prototypes.umbralLayer: Wyld Pocket: Plant spirits retain unusual coherence and memory within the managed urban greenhouse.
prototypes.awakenedVector: Verbena Grove: Living patterns can be studied or cultivated beneath the cover of municipal botany.

mundaneBase.name: Automotive Salvage Yard
mundaneBase.description: Crushed vehicles, broken glass, and mud pits leak dark oil into the surrounding soil.

prototypes.kindredLayer: Brujah Staging Ground: Heavy machinery noise can conceal meetings, training, and political organizing.
prototypes.umbralLayer: Weaver-Wyrm Conflict Zone: Toxic elementals and machinery spirits compete over the contaminated ground.
prototypes.awakenedVector: Hermetic Forge: Scrap metal is tested for symbolic history and reused in defensive occult construction.

mundaneBase.name: Steam Ventilation Vault
mundaneBase.description: A bricked utility access point vents scalding vapor into the night air.

prototypes.kindredLayer: Nosferatu Escape Hatch: A concealed mechanism opens into utility and sewer passages below street level.
prototypes.umbralLayer: Steam Elemental Nest: Spirits of pressure and heat gather around the active infrastructure.
prototypes.awakenedVector: Athanor Matrix: Thermal differences can support alchemical refinement while remaining hidden inside ordinary utilities.

mundaneBase.name: Historic Churchyard
mundaneBase.description: Weathered slate markers stand beneath iron gates and mature trees.

prototypes.kindredLayer: Hecata Vault: An ancestral crypt may serve as an anchor for necromantic records and obligations.
prototypes.umbralLayer: Silent Verge: The boundary between the living city and its dead is unusually close around the oldest graves.
prototypes.awakenedVector: Celestial Chorus Node: Sustained faith and ritual history create a stabilizing resonance around the grounds.

contextVariants.title: Routine Commerce
contextVariants.effect: The location is exactly what it appears to be: an ordinary business or civic site serving regular customers.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: Use mundane staffing, pricing, scheduling, and customer conflict only.

contextVariants.title: Ordinary Maintenance
contextVariants.effect: Recent oddities are explained by repairs, inspections, utility work, or deferred maintenance.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: A repair deadline or contractor dispute complicates access.

contextVariants.title: Staff Turnover
contextVariants.effect: Unfamiliar faces and inconsistent stories come from hiring problems, resignations, or management changes.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: A new employee misunderstands a harmless situation.

contextVariants.title: Delivery Window
contextVariants.effect: Late-night traffic and locked doors are connected to deliveries, inventory control, and ordinary loss prevention.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: A delayed shipment creates a practical obstacle.

contextVariants.title: Neighborhood Convenience
contextVariants.effect: The site matters because residents use it, not because supernatural factions control it.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: Local residents defend the location from disruption.

contextVariants.title: Quiet After Hours
contextVariants.effect: The building becomes empty and eerie after closing, but there is no confirmed supernatural use.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: Security alarms and ordinary patrols are the main danger.

contextVariants.title: Minor Code Complaint
contextVariants.effect: Rumors of secrecy originate in permit disputes, sanitation complaints, fire-code concerns, or zoning enforcement.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: Municipal paperwork creates a time-sensitive complication.

contextVariants.title: Seasonal Slowdown
contextVariants.effect: Reduced activity, dark windows, and irregular hours reflect seasonal economics rather than hidden occupation.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: The site may close temporarily without sinister cause.

contextVariants.title: Renovation Noise
contextVariants.effect: Unusual sounds, covered windows, and restricted rooms come from remodeling or structural work.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: Construction exposes an entirely ordinary but inconvenient hazard.

contextVariants.title: Public Event
contextVariants.effect: Crowds and unusual schedules are tied to a fundraiser, sale, meeting, performance, or community program.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: Public attention makes covert action difficult.

contextVariants.title: Local Gossip
contextVariants.effect: The location has accumulated stories because it is old, unpopular, or socially important, not because those stories are true.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: A rumor spreads faster than the facts.

contextVariants.title: Financial Strain
contextVariants.effect: Short staffing, odd transactions, and unusual hours are symptoms of debt, rent pressure, or declining business.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: A mundane creditor or landlord forces a decision.

contextVariants.title: Historical Echo
contextVariants.effect: The building has a documented history connected to an older incident, but no current supernatural occupation is confirmed.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: Research reveals a past connection without proving a present one.

contextVariants.title: Passing Witness
contextVariants.effect: Someone associated with the supernatural once visited, worked nearby, or was seen here briefly.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: A witness remembers one useful but incomplete detail.

contextVariants.title: Route Adjacency
contextVariants.effect: The site sits near a known feeding route, spirit path, occult boundary, or surveillance corridor without being part of it.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: Activity passes nearby but does not originate here.

contextVariants.title: Residual Resonance
contextVariants.effect: A faint emotional, spiritual, or magical residue remains from an event that happened elsewhere or long ago.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: Sensitive characters notice a trace that cannot identify a current actor.

contextVariants.title: Accidental Shelter
contextVariants.effect: A supernatural figure used the location once out of convenience, with no enduring claim or infrastructure.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: Evidence points to temporary use rather than ownership.

contextVariants.title: Unverified Rumor
contextVariants.effect: The location appears in informal stories and secondhand warnings but not in any reliable inventory.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: Following the rumor produces ambiguity rather than confirmation.

contextVariants.title: Concealed Use
contextVariants.effect: The location is being used by supernatural actors, but the arrangement is unofficial, temporary, or deliberately omitted from faction records.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: Discovery creates leverage because no one can safely admit ownership.

contextVariants.title: Recurring Anomaly
contextVariants.effect: A repeatable supernatural effect is present, yet no faction has accepted responsibility or completed a formal survey.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: The anomaly escalates whenever investigators attempt to classify it.

contextVariants.title: Formal Domain Entry
contextVariants.effect: The location is formally catalogued, monitored, claimed, or administratively recognized by at least one supernatural organization.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: Any intrusion risks an organized response from the recorded custodian.
